title: The SIM kiosk wants two photos
scenario: An airport SIM seller says local law requires a passport photo for activation. After taking it, the clerk also asks to photograph both sides of your bank card “for the payment file.”

answers.A: Use an official carrier shop or app instead if the kiosk cannot explain its data-handling process.
answers.B: Allow both photos if the clerk covers the security code on the back of the card.
answers.C: Verify what ID is legally required and pay through a normal terminal; do not allow a photo of your payment card.

explanation: Some countries legitimately require ID for SIM registration, but that does not justify copying unrelated payment credentials.
proTip: A legitimate ID requirement does not make every extra data request legitimate.
